entries.title: Chronos
entries.definitive_edition: Chronos: Before the Ashes on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the non-VR PC release for a normal stream capture route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern non-VR PC presentation with standard capture.

primary.why: Chronos: Before the Ashes is the best main route because it is the overhauled non-VR version of Gunfire's original Chronos, released on PC and consoles as a prequel to Remnant: From the Ashes. It removes the Oculus Rift-only restriction while keeping the full action-adventure structure available for normal capture.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Chronos: Before the Ashes on Steam or GOG and play the Windows PC build. Treat the 2016 Oculus Rift version as a historical VR-original route rather than the main playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: Before the Ashes is an overhauled non-VR release of Chronos and serves as a prequel to Remnant: From the Ashes; keep the original Oculus Rift route separate as historical context.

entries.title: Remnant: From the Ashes
entries.definitive_edition: Remnant: From the Ashes - Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Complete Edition with both DLC packs installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with all DLC.

primary.why: The Windows PC Complete Edition is the best route because it includes the base game, Swamps of Corsus, and Subject 2923 on the same platform, with PC capture/settings flexibility. The next-gen console patch improves PS5/Xbox Series play, but the PC Complete Edition remains the cleanest fidelity-and-completeness route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Remnant: From the Ashes - Complete Edition on Steam or GOG and install both DLCs. Play the base campaign, then Swamps of Corsus content and Subject 2923 for the story conclusion.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS5/Xbox Series patch improves console performance, but it does not replace the PC Complete Edition as the main archival route.

entries.title: Remnant II
entries.definitive_edition: Remnant II Ultimate Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with all DLC and current updates installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with the complete DLC bundle.

primary.why: The Windows PC Ultimate Edition is the best route because it covers the base game, the survival pack, the Remnant: From the Ashes armor sets, and the full three-pack DLC bundle, including The Awakened King, The Forgotten Kingdom, and The Dark Horizon. PC also keeps the best capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Remnant II Ultimate Edition on Steam or use the base game plus DLC Bundle. Install all three DLC packs and the current free Boss Rush update before starting a long run.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Dark Horizon is documented as the third and final premium DLC, with Boss Rush as a free update; revisit only if a later complete edition changes packaging.
